name: Vexor Custom Woodworking Tools
old_description: Vexor creates custom router bits and custom insert tooling for woodworking applications.
about:
Vexor Custom Woodworking Tools operates from Denver, Colorado, where it designs and manufactures custom router bits and insert tooling for woodworking applications. The company also provides sharpening, reconditioning, and balancing services for a wide range of cutting tools.

Its product line includes custom router bits, shaper cutters, and the Multi-Pro family of insert tooling, which allows users to swap profiles without purchasing dedicated tools. Vexor runs a machine shop equipped with a diverse range of CNC machines, including five-axis milling centers, enabling it to produce tooling and offer contract machining services. Every tool is balanced to the industry standard grade for its rated RPM.

The company serves woodworking businesses that require precision cutting tools and maintenance services. Customers include cabinet shops, furniture makers, and other wood-processing operations that rely on router bits, shaper cutters, and insert tooling for production.

Vexor emphasizes personal service and competitive pricing, positioning itself as a one-stop shop for custom tooling and sharpening. The Multi-Pro system was developed to give customers flexibility and reduce the cost of profile changes compared to traditional dedicated insert tooling.
